items.t: Dual-clutch (DSG/S tronic) gearbox jerks, slips or loses gears
items.job: Replace dual-clutch mechatronic unit (or clutch pack)
items.note: A fluid and filter service alone costs far less and is worth trying first if codes allow. CarComplaints owners report about $2,900 on average.

items.t: Timing belt breaks and damages the engine
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and water pump
items.note: If the belt has already broken, a cylinder head rebuild usually adds $2,000-5,000.

items.t: Instrument cluster gauges and display fail
items.job: Rebuild instrument cluster (remove, send out, refit)
items.note: A new cluster costs much more and needs dealer coding.

items.t: Automatic transmission stuck in one gear (limp mode)
items.job: Replace automatic transmission valve body and refill fluid
items.note: A used transmission is about $1,000 plus installation. A full replacement can reach $7,500 at a dealer.

items.t: Ignition coil failure causes misfires
items.note: Audi-brand coils are about $200-300 a set; aftermarket sets about $100. Plugs are often done at the same time.

items.t: Cam follower wears and damages the fuel pump
items.job: Inspect and replace high-pressure fuel pump cam follower
items.note: If the camshaft and fuel pump are already damaged the bill can reach about $2,000.

items.t: Carbon buildup on the intake valves
items.note: EnginePatrol puts professional cleaning at about $500.

items.t: Thermostat housing leaks coolant
items.job: Replace thermostat housing and thermostat, refill coolant
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $720-975 for a TT thermostat replacement.

items.t: Water pump leaks coolant (extended warranty)
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat assembly
items.note: May be covered by the settlement's extended warranty; the settlement caps independent-shop reimbursement at $1,150.

items.t: Convertible top flap motors fail (Roadster)
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $1,100 on average.

items.t: Timing chain rattle and stretch on the 3.2L V6
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Labor-heavy because the gearbox side of the engine must be opened up.

items.t: Magnetic ride shocks leak
items.job: Replace magnetic ride shocks (one axle pair)
items.note: EnginePatrol puts them at $500-800 each, or $2,000-3,000 for all four.

items.t: Tail light connector melts or corrodes
items.job: Replace tail light connector and bulb holder

items.t: Mass airflow sensor failure
Vacuum hoses crack and leak
items.job: Smoke test and replace vacuum hoses

items.t: Power window regulator or motor fails
items.job: Replace window regulator (and motor if needed)

items.t: Virtual cockpit slow to start up
Front control arms and anti-roll bar parts wear
items.job: Replace front lower control arms and anti-roll bar links, align

items.t: Brakes squeal, especially when cold
Car can lose stability in fast sharp turns (recall)
Fuel line may leak from production damage (recall)
Rear control arm bushing can corrode and bind (recall)
Driver airbag inflator can absorb moisture (recall)
Aftermarket water pump pulley can crack and break the timing belt (recall)
Gearbox clutch weld defect can let the car roll (recall)
Fuel tank vent valve can leak fuel (recall)
Gearbox can suddenly shift to neutral (recall)
Fuel tank can be punctured in a crash (recall)
